inventedEvidence.evidence: 'Please don't keep resetting the trip' - the customer never mentioned any trip or resetting anything; they said it restarts by itself after cooling

rationale: The assistant correctly identified restricted airflow and the kinked hose as the likely cause in turn 1 and eventually told the customer to straighten and clear the hose, which matches the hidden truth. However, every turn opened with the same verbatim boilerplate about 'resetting the trip' (never mentioned by the customer), turn 2 asked a vented-dryer owner to rinse a condenser unit, and turn 3 leaked internal instructions ('Already told them (do not repeat any of it; build on it)... Your first draft repeated one of your earlier replies word for word') while contradicting itself by both giving a DIY fix and insisting an engineer must check it before any use. The landlord was never mentioned and the mandatory electrician/engineer referral is over-escalation for a crushed hose, leaving a real homeowner confused rather than well served.
